scope: LLVM 21 MCA of the actual linked c9g selected-group straight-line region only; no build, worker launch, benchmark, source edit or modified instruction sequence.

primary_source.observed_definition: Both neoverse-v2 and neoverse-v3 ProcessorModel definitions select NeoverseV2Model. ProcessorFeatures and Tune definitions remain distinct.
primary_source.terminology: Shared scheduling model, not a complete CPU alias.

useful_instruction_model_observations: The q-load is modeled as latency 6; widening, prefix and most vector operations as latency 2.
GPR-to-vector dup is modeled as latency 3; addv as 2 uOps/latency 5; fmov as 2 uOps/latency 2.
The four V2Unit vector resources carry the prefix/compare/reduction work. These are model assumptions and do not describe measured c9g scheduling.
interpretation: 38 single-iteration total cycles include simulated dispatch/retirement start and drain and the model 6-cycle load; not measured c9g latency.
17021/1000=17.021 cycles per repeated region includes the artificial scalar recurrence explicitly present in the critical-sequence report; not independent-query throughput.
Block RThroughput4.8 is the scheduling model reciprocal-throughput estimate ignoring dependency chains; not latency, measured throughput or a guaranteed sustained rate.
Identical V2/V3 output is expected from the shared NeoverseV2Model and supplies no independent evidence about actual V3 relative scheduling uplift.
Instruction latencies and V2Unit resource use are assumptions of this model. They do not measure cache tier, page translation, branch prediction, LLC or DRAM service.
The complete query additionally pays query generation, checkpoint selection/base load, group-base rank addition, tomb lookup and output/checksum work.

repeat_dependency.classification: Artificial rank output to checkpoint-base input recurrence
repeat_dependency.real_consumer_definition_that_breaks_rec: 0x18e10 ldr w6,[x6,w20,uxtw#2], before each group region; query w19 is also regenerated.

conclusion: The model can describe dependencies and resource assumptions in this slice, but the V2/V3 CPU flags do not distinguish scheduling uplift. The 1000-iteration total contains an extraction-created scalar recurrence, so neither 17.021 cycles/region nor 38 single-iteration cycles is an actual consumer cost. Preserve the independent full-consumer benchmark evidence.
